requirement.statement: Halfcode SHALL load AI workflow definitions as explicit profile Units while preserving their substrate definitions.

suite.name: Profile 与 substrate 双层身份

case.given: AppBundle 注册 `ai-ctrl-workflow` 且 source 根为 `AICtrlWorkflow`
case.then: 结果 SHALL 保留 `AICtrlWorkflow` profile 与 `WorkCtrlFlow` substrate definition

case.given: AppBundle 注册 `ai-data-workflow` 且 source 根为 `AIDataWorkflow`
case.then: 结果 SHALL 保留 `AIDataWorkflow` profile 与 `EagerDataFlow` substrate definition

case.given: Unit kind 与 source profile root 不一致
case.then: 结果 SHALL 产生稳定 kind mismatch diagnostic

case.given: 合法 AI workflow Unit 已加载
case.then: 结果 SHALL NOT 创建 controller、RunGraph、runtime handle 或执行动态代码
